clips.title: The story
paras: Secure the Mountain is an Alliance quest addressing the sudden surge of wendigos overrunning the Grizzled Den in Dun Morogh. Adventurers are sent into the infested cavern to locate an overeager dwarven scout named Cornelius and recover a critical report for Whitebeard.

Dwarven scouts monitoring the frigid mountain slopes face trouble on two fronts. Aside from the ever-present Frostmane troll threat, the local wendigos have begun multiplying aggressively, abandoning their usual solitary hollows to pack into the Grizzled Den to the north. These savage beasts make traveling the crags perilous for patrols and couriers alike.

A scout named Cornelius charged headfirst into the Grizzled Den to secure a vital report intended for Whitebeard. His impulsive bravery left his partner stranded outside, seeking capable adventurers willing to delve into the beast-packed cave, track down the reckless dwarf, and thin out the ferocious wendigo population.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: It's bad enough havin' a troll problem, but the mountains are filled tae the brim with wendigos! They normally keep to their own caves, but they seem tae be spreadin' like bunnies. Now they've filled the Grizzled Den north of here.
If we want Whitebeard's report, we're gonna need to find my partner Cornelius. The blockhead got a little too excited and charged in head first. Brave, but stupid.
Head into the cave and see where he is. And feel free to take out some of the beasts while yer at it.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thank ye for the help, friend. Guess we have our report.
